messages:
Oncall Bot: [PAGER] 03:12 UTC - gpu-pool-east: sustained queue growth, autoscaler failed to provision beyond 48 GPUs due to scale-limit error. Investigate immediately.
Maria Cheng: Looking. I'm seeing steady enqueue rate from the text-generation queue. Per-shard pending requests ~900. CPU on scheduler ok but scheduler reports placement failures.
Sam Patel: Any errors in the allocator logs? Could be MIG sizing mismatch again.
Jordan Lee: Allocator dump shows a bunch of 1g MIG slices unused because requests need 2g compat. Felt like we hit binpack fragmentation.
Lee Nguyen: Confirming. From the placement layer: "no compatible node found for pod: required_mig=2g, available_slices=[1g,1g,1g,...]". Large contiguous 2g units absent.
Maria Cheng: That explains queue backing up. Autoscaler attempted to add nodes but cloud quota is at 50 GPUs for this project and we've hit soft quota. The scale attempt returns 403/QUOTA_EXCEEDED.
Infra Pager: Noted. Quota ticket already opened (TKT-98765) but not immediate. We need an in-cluster mitigation.
Sam Patel: Short term options: 1) Lower request size to accept 1g slices by routing certain low-memory models to 1g-compatible variants. 2) Throttle non-critical background jobs. 3) Emergency repack to split a 8g node into 2g slices? Emergency repack risky at peak.
Jordan Lee: Can we fallback to smaller model variant for <=10% of requests? If we can configure routing policy (latency tier) to downgrade non-enterprise traffic, that frees 8-10 GPUs worth.
Maria Cheng: Action plan: (A) Start throttling batch rerank jobs via feature-flag; (B) Create routing rule to prefer 1g-compat model variants for free-trial customers; (C) If queue doesn't drop in 10m, initiate emergency repack schedule.
Lee Nguyen: I'm toggling batch rerank flag now: /ops toggle-feature batch-rerank --off :gear: 
Oncall Bot: [ACTION] Maria Cheng assigned - live coordinator. Sam Patel and Jordan Lee are primary infra leads.
Sam Patel: Running allocator probe to locate candidate nodes for repack:
```
# run on allocator master
curl -s http://allocator.internal/pools/gpu-pool-east/units | jq '.[] | {node_id, free_slices, mig_profile}'
```
Sam Patel: Found three nodes with a single 8g slice each that if repacked could produce 4x2g slices. Repack will cause short term pod evictions (~30-60s) and may increase disruption.
Jordan Lee: Does the runtime support hot-repack without draining model caches? Not safely; we'll lose KV cache entries for any evicted pods. Expect latency spike.
Maria Cheng: I'm posting an internal customer-impact note to #support now: "Experiencing throttling on some hosted endpoints in us-east-1; teams may see 503s or increased latencies while we mitigate." @support please surface higher-severity tickets if customer SLA impacted.
Infra Pager: Support acknowledged. CS routing: contacting top 5 enterprise accounts for heads-up.
Lee Nguyen: Attempting a local scaling tweak: temporarily raise per-region autoscaler max from 48 -> 64 (soft override) to permit cloud API to allocate if quota allows. Command:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap autoscaler-config -p '{"data":{"max_gpus":"64"}}'
```
Lee Nguyen: Patch applied. Cloud still returns QUOTA_EXCEEDED on scale attempt. No luck.
Sam Patel: Ok fallback then: begin selective routing changes. Jordan, can you push the canary routing?
Jordan Lee: Pushing now. Routing patch:
```
PATCH /routing/policy
{ "selector": "tier==free_trial", "prefer_mig_profile": "1g" }
```
Jordan Lee: Patch applied to 20% traffic -> immediate drop in pending queue from 900 -> 720. Good signal.
Maria Cheng: Keep it at 20% and increase throttling on background rerank by 50%. Monitoring latency and error-rate.
Oncall Bot: [UPDATE] 03:30 UTC - queue length decreased 25% after routing and toggles. No customer escalations yet.
Sam Patel: Still see many 2g-required inflight. If routing + throttles don't bring us under 600 pending, we should proceed with repack window.
Jordan Lee: We have a candidate node pool with lower utilization. Proposal: cordon 2 nodes and repack one at a time, drain pods with graceful timeout 45s, then run repack tool. Repack command snippet: 
```
repackctl --node node-abc --from-profile 8g --to-profiles 4x2g --force
```
Jordan Lee: I'm ready but want signoff from Maria (customer impact) and Sam (infra risk).
Maria Cheng: Sam and I discussed. We will authorize one-node repack if pending > 650 at next 5m check. Current pending: 615. Hold for 5m.
Lee Nguyen: Monitoring memory pressure and cache miss ratio; will snapshot caches pre-repack.
Oncall Bot: [CHECKPOINT] 03:40 UTC - pending 605 -> decision hold.
Sam Patel: Pending trend flattens, good. If quota ticket resolves (unlikely quick), we can avoid repack.
Infra Pager: CS update: two enterprise customers reported increased tail latency but no 503s. They're being routed to dedicated capacity if needed.
Maria Cheng: Ok we're stabilizing. Keep routing patch in place, keep rerank throttled. Sam/Jordan please prepare repack runbook and rehearse on staging. We'll schedule the repack off-peak if still needed. Postmortem scheduled in 24h.
Sam Patel: Noted. I'll also file follow-up to review MIG sizing defaults for models; we should aim to prefer 1g-compatible variants where possible to reduce fragmentation.
Jordan Lee: Also add automations: when cloud quota blocks scale, autoscaler should auto-trigger routing/drain policies before letting queue grow unbounded.
Maria Cheng: Thanks team. I'll stay on the thread and hand off at 04:00 UTC to the next on-call (Lee).
Lee Nguyen: Taking handoff at 04:00 UTC. I'll keep monitoring for 2h.
Oncall Bot: [HANDOFF] 03:59 UTC - Handoff to Lee Nguyen. Incident channel mode: triage.
Maria Cheng: Final note before handoff: incident severity P2, customer-impact limited, mitigations applied. Post-incident action items: quota escalation, repack runbook, routing automation, model-mig defaults.
Infra Pager: Logged incident: INC-2026-4130008888. All actions and timestamps recorded.
Oncall Bot: [CLOSECHECK] 04:20 UTC - queue stable < 400, autoscaler healthy, no further scale attempts blocked. Recommend monitoring window open for 2 hours then close.
Lee Nguyen: Monitoring window complete. I'll file the postmortem draft and assign owners. Great response — saving repack as last resort worked. :thumbsup:
Maria Cheng: Thanks everyone. I'll circulate customer-facing summary and postmortem link in 1h.
